title: ClassVision: AI-Powered Classroom Attendance System
abstract: arXiv:2608.26173v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Students and working professionals have to go through the attendance process every day. Traditional methods of marking attendance using pen and paper or online platforms are human-intensive and time-consuming. To address the challenges in manual attendance processes, this research explores the use of face detection (FD) and face recognition (FR) technology to automate the attendance process, particularly in educational settings, and build a ClassVision course attendance system. We also propose an automated attendance system featuring a human-computer interaction (HCI) and user-friendly web interface that utilizes real-time image processing to identify and recognize students in classrooms and automatically record their attendance. We identified RetinaFace as the best face detection model, and when combined with Face Recognition for verification, it provided the most promising results with a cropped embedding of 50x50 pixels.

translated_title: ClassVision：基于人工智能的课堂考勤系统
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26173v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：学生和职场人士每天都需要经历考勤过程。传统使用纸笔或在线平台标记考勤的方法耗时且劳动密集。为解决人工考勤流程中的挑战，本研究探索使用人脸检测（FD）和人脸识别（FR）技术来自动化考勤过程，特别是在教育环境中，并构建了一个ClassVision课程考勤系统。我们还提出了一种自动化考勤系统，其特点是具有人机交互（HCI）和用户友好的网页界面，利用实时图像处理来识别课堂中的学生并自动记录其出勤情况。我们确定RetinaFace为最佳人脸检测模型，当与Face Recognition进行验证结合时，在裁剪嵌入为50x50像素的情况下提供了最有希望的结果。
tldr: 本文提出并构建了一个基于人脸检测与识别技术的自动化课堂考勤系统ClassVision，结合RetinaFace模型和实时图像处理，旨在减少人工考勤的时间和劳动成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes and builds ClassVision, an automated classroom attendance system using face detection and recognition, integrating RetinaFace with real-time image processing to reduce time and labor costs of manual attendance.
